result.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning Is an Integration Problem
result.comment: 39 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Playable companion and source code: https://github.com/fractalbrain-ai/10d-game
result.summary: This paper presents an opinionated set of ten desiderata intended to inform the design and evaluation of reinforcement-learning agents that learn continually throughout a continuing lifetime. We use these desiderata to examine a representative selection of existing approaches. Progress on individual desiderata is valuable, but the longer-term aim should be to integrate all ten within a single agent. To our knowledge, no published evaluation has yet provided evidence for such an integration. Likewise, the representative benchmarks we review probe different parts of this target, but separate evaluations do not establish that the corresponding properties coexist within one agent throughout a continuing lifetime. As a secondary contribution, we therefore present a compact persistent-world scenario as a playable companion to the desiderata and outline a proposed benchmark that examines a broad range of associated behavioral capabilities together within one such lifetime.

AI.brief_summary: 该文以致述方式提出持续强化学习应满足的十项设计需求（desiderata），用其审视若干代表性方法，并指出尚无已发表评估证明这些性质能在单一智能体的连续生命周期内同时成立；为此另提供一个可交互的持久世界场景与相应基准设想。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心主张——多机制需在同一智能体内整合、并由同一生命周期内的统一评估检验——可能启发 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本与支持组合、以及长度泛化的联合评测设计；但该文不涉及视觉状态表示，具体可迁移的评估程序仍需核查。
